displayName: OCI-AUTH-006: Authentication — Failed Login Then Success (Password Compromise)
description:
Detects failed login followed by success from same source indicating potential password compromise

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_auth_006", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%authentication%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%failed%') AND "value" > 0
